name: Progress MS-36 (97P)
destination_explanation: The station circles Earth about 400 km up, once every 90 minutes. Visiting spacecraft usually spend hours to a few days catching up before they dock.
slot_a_text: The T-0 is unconfirmed. The window is instantaneous, so it goes on time or not at all.
slot_b_text: The 8th launch of the year for Russia's Roscosmos, 346th all time. No Soyuz 2.1b has failed in 25 flights. It is the 272nd orbital launch attempt worldwide this year.

lg_slot_b_text: The International Space Station programme is tied together by a complex set of legal, political and financial agreements between the sixteen nations involved in the project, governing ownership of the various components, rights to crewing and utilization, and responsibilities for crew rotation and resupply of the International Space Station.
lg_slot_c_text: The Soyuz 'periscope' used by the crew for docking alignment is a literal system of mirrors sticking out of the capsule.
